title: Disclosure-tiered prompt optimization: code and data
description:
Harness and data release for the manuscript Disclosure-Constrained Prompt Optimization for Local LLMs: A Controlled Study on Synthetic CVE Applicability Rules (Bednárik, Gogolák, Sárosi), submitted to Computers, Materials & Continua.

The harness/ folder holds the experiment code (MIT License). The data/ folder holds the benchmark, the source-corroboration recipe, the calibration records and the scientific records of every run (CC BY 4.0). harness/scripts/make_tables.py regenerates every table and figure of the paper from the released data without any model call.

Version 1.1 accompanies the revised manuscript. It adds the revision's follow-up runs (local self-optimization, a Shuffled Abstraction control, naive-prompt re-checks), a Real-Record Panel of real CVE records with hand labels and a blind label audit, the scripts that regenerate the revision's analyses from the released data, and a supplementary/ folder with the figures and tables moved out of the paper. The records of version 1.0 are unchanged.
notes: Code in harness/ is released under the MIT License; data in data/ under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the archive.
